rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for drawing air into and expelling it from the lungs.

example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 wan6 dung6 jiu3 maan6 maan6 fu1 kap1

rows.note: Use this specifically when you mean expelling air rather than the whole breathing process.

example.jyutping: kap1 hei3 zi1 hau6 maan6 maan6 fu1 hei3

rows.note: Use this for clothes or materials that let air pass through, especially in descriptions of comfort or ventilation.

example.english: This shirt lets you breathe easily, so it does not feel stuffy in summer.
example.traditional: 呢件恤衫好透氣，夏天着都唔焗。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 seot1 saam1 hou2 tau3 hei3 haa6 tin1 zoek3 dou1 m4 guk6

rows.note: Use this when something gives off a smell or conveys an atmosphere or impression; it is not for ordinary human exhalation.

example.english: This old house seems to breathe out a spooky atmosphere.
example.traditional: 呢間舊屋好似散發出一陣陰森嘅氣氛。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gau6 uk1 hou2 ci5 saan3 faat3 ceot1 jat1 zan6 jam1 sam1 ge3 hei3 fan1
